title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption evolves in a population under social influence, policies, supply constraints, and information campaigns.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Persons update mask-wearing propensity based on the behavior of their social network neighbors.

interactions.name: norm_observation_at_locations
interactions.description: Persons observe mask usage at locations and adjust perceived norms and future compliance.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask requirements, potentially denying entry or issuing warnings/fines to non-compliant persons.

interactions.name: policy_setting
interactions.description: Public health authority sets or updates mask mandates and enforcement levels.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Persons purchase masks from retailers subject to stock levels, price, and purchase limits.

interactions.name: information_diffusion
interactions.description: Media channels and public health authority broadcast messages that affect risk perception and trust.

interactions.name: supply_constraint_feedback
interactions.description: Retailer stock shortages increase prices and reduce immediate adoption even if intent is high.

interactions.name: habit_formation
interactions.description: Repeated mask use increases habit strength, making future compliance more likely even if external signals weaken.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the population wearing a mask at each time step and averaged over the simulation.

metrics.name: subgroup_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rates by demographic or socioeconomic subgroups (e.g., age_group, occupation_type, income quantiles).

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Number of days until overall adoption reaches or exceeds a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mean adoption rate over the final N days of the simulation (e.g., last 14 days).

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption metrics between scenarios with and without mandates/enforcement.

metrics.name: noncompliance_incidents_per_1000_entries
metrics.description: Rate of detected non-compliance events at locations normalized per 1000 entry attempts.

metrics.name: mask_shortage_days
metrics.description: Total days during which aggregate mask demand exceeds retailer stock, indicating supply constraints.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality in adoption across subgroups, e.g., Gini coefficient of subgroup adoption rates.

validation_criteria.name: convergence_criterion
validation_criteria.description: Model is considered converged if the absolute change in overall adoption rate is below epsilon for the specified sliding window.

validation_criteria.name: threshold_reached
validation_criteria.description: Success if overall adoption reaches the target_adoption_threshold by a specified day (if provided).

validation_criteria.name: calibration_rmse_below_threshold
validation_criteria.description: If empirical adoption data are available, the RMSE between simulated and observed adoption series must be below a chosen threshold.
